notes: Printer Bot 3.0.0 adds up to 100 printers, rules that choose the printer for each event, 8.5x11 inch paper in black and white or color with a large message layout, pictures from Imgur, Catbox and ImgBB in messages, and backups of your settings. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, restart Streamer.bot and reload the dock. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.0.0 on GitHub.
